title: Sonorousness
summary: SONO'ROUSNESS, noun 1. The quality of yielding sound when struck or coming in collision with another body; as the sonorousness of metals. 2. Having or giving a loud or clear sound; as the sonorousness

inlines.v: SONO'ROUSNESS, noun 1. The quality of yielding sound when struck or coming in collision with another body; as the sonorousness of metals. 2. Having or giving a loud or clear sound; as the sonorousness of a voice or an instrument. 3. Magnificence of sound.
